name: Cinderwheel Foundry
record: The furnace ledger ends mid-shift. Spare metal was sealed in the stores.

name: Last Lantern Watch
record: The watch withdrew toward the towns. The supply room was never emptied.

name: Shrine of the Empty Bell
record: Pilgrims sheltered here before the road fell silent. Offerings remain.

name: Salt Road Caravanserai
record: A faded manifest lists food, cloth and a caravan that never returned.

name: Splitrock Quarry Works
record: The cutting crews fled the quarry. Tools and ore lie behind the works.

name: Redoubt Nine
record: A last order reads: hold until relieved. No relief ever came.

name: White Reed Infirmary
record: A medic's note asks travelers to leave dressings for the next wounded soul.

name: Derelict Freight Yard
record: Abandoned freight crates carry the marks of three rival settlements.

name: Black Kiln Factory
record: Cold kilns and sealed stores outlived the workers. Salvagers came later.

name: Broken Signal Station
record: The signal crew recorded lights moving beyond the dunes before vanishing.

name: Sunken Road Sanctuary
record: The sanctuary register names refugees from villages no longer on the road.

name: Hollow Mule Waystation
record: The stable hands hid emergency rations when the caravans stopped coming.

name: Ironwake Pump Works
record: A maintenance slate warns of a seized pump. Replacement parts remain.

name: Ashgate Border Fort
record: The gate changed hands many times. Its last garrison left weapons behind.

name: Pale Glass Hospice
record: The beds are empty. A locked-away supply chest survived the evacuation.

name: Long Haul Exchange
record: Freight accounts stop on the same day. Something interrupted the handover.

name: Amber Lantern Refuge
record: Caravan crews keep this courtyard open. The upper galleries shelter travelers.

name: Kestrel Relay Citadel
record: The relay still transmits. Its machine wardens guard the command store above.

name: Needleglass Archive
record: A sealed repository records the last years of the old world. Its guardians never stood down.

name: Copperhook Guild Yard
record: Scrappers trade parts below and maintain a communal sleeping gallery above.

name: Nine Wheels Turbine Plant
record: Conduits lead from the turbine floor to a protected control vault.

name: Blue Spring Pumpworks
record: Mineral stains mark the old waterline. Something metal still patrols the pumps.

name: Reedward Fishing Lodge
record: Fishers and reed cutters share meals and dry beds beside the marsh road.

name: High Ash Survey Post
record: Surveyors map shifting routes from this defended post and trade spare field supplies.

name: Glass Saint Cloister
record: Archivists preserve maps on the upper floors. Their private caches are watched.

name: Saltcoil Smuggler Exchange
record: Smugglers trade in a maze of old freight rooms. They guard the exchange fiercely.

name: Morrow Observatory
record: The telescope has fallen silent, but the sentinels still protect its precision instruments.

name: Red Sluice Reclamation Works
record: Flood controls and maintenance corridors conceal a locked-away supply reserve.

name: Wayfarer Stonehouse
record: A family maintains this refuge for passing caravans. Keep your hands out of their stores.

name: Cracked Crown Redoubt
record: A well-equipped raiding crew has fortified the barracks and claimed the upper armory.

name: Wrenfall Field Hospital
record: Volunteer medics offer a safe rest and trade dressings from their old dispensary.

name: Deep Bell Repository
record: Catalog numbers descend into forgotten centuries. A core warden waits in the final vault.

name: Rust Orchard Work Camp
record: Harvest crews repair their tools here and barter recovered metal.

name: Shogunate Road Bastion
record: An organized border garrison keeps watch from the roof and trades ordinary supplies below.

name: Ivory Kiln Annex
record: Ceramic workshops and shuttered stores now shelter armed scavengers.

name: Snowline Expedition Lodge
record: Survey parties leave trail reports on the tables and sleep above the trading room.

name: Sable Rail Terminus
record: Sorting galleries feed a secure freight store. Patrol machines still enforce the old inventory rules.

name: Sunspoke Pilgrim House
record: Pilgrims rest below a quiet archive. Supplies belong to the keepers.

name: Ash Moth Salvage Fortress
record: A raider captain has built a defensible maze around a rich salvage cache.

name: Stillwater Condenser
record: The condenser chambers echo with a six-legged maintenance crawler.

name: Buried Meridian Station
record: Old-world cable trunks converge beneath an intact command vault. Its defense system remains active.

name: Dune Shepherd Encampment
record: Herders keep a modest bunkhouse, water jars and a small supply counter here.

name: Cinder Tax Outpost
record: A remote watch detachment occupies the old fort and sells surplus rations.

name: Hollow Engine Cathedral
record: A vast machine hall rises through three levels. Heavy wardens patrol the control galleries.

name: Broken Chain Refuge
record: Freed workers have made this abandoned clinic into a defended refuge.

name: Last Horizon Vault
record: The final survey ledger names a sealed cache above the archive. Its guardian carries the vault inventory.
